description: Build a resident grid-wide n=512 QR megakernel that fuses FP32 Householder panels with tiled compact-WY updates without sacrificing GPU-wide parallelism: keep V/T in global slabs, schedule 128-column tcgen05/TMA update tasks through a device work queue, and use safe fully-resident phase barriers plus compensated TF32 arithmetic.

Resident 128-CTA grid with 32-matrix waves, FP32 NB32 panel owners, global V/T slabs, queued 128-column updates, and fully-resident epoch barriers; differential guard reached the n512 route but NVRTC rejected the added math.h include.

Removed unavailable math.h include; resident FP32 grid passed validation and all guards. Full geomean 1652.002351 us; dense batch640 n512 measured 93196.353 us. Nsys attributes 92.878 ms entirely to qr2_n512_resident_grid_fp32.
